"""Main owns fetching the newly observed Xe revision; no GPU execution."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
X = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata')
W = X / '.worktree/bench-xestrata-b9f00e9-pristine-20261013'
HEAD = 'b9f00e9db7fd56decdd9930ee84049d980b904e4'
OLD = 'da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('xe_update_fetch_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
env = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
           GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')
with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-current-xe-b9-fetch-root-v1'
    m.require(not out.exists() and not W.exists(), 'fresh source and receipt')
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], evidence={},
             controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), owner_sha256=m.sha(O),
             started_utc=m.utc(), gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False,
             old_revision=OLD, observed_revision=HEAD)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    save()
    def cmd(label, argv):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, X, wall=180, cpu=180,
                             text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20,
                             file_cap=32 << 20, rss_cap=2 << 30)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label)
        return so.read_text().strip()
    try:
        m.require(cmd('root-branch', ['/usr/bin/git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'main', 'root default branch')
        r['root_head'] = cmd('root-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        cmd('fetch-observed-revision', ['/usr/bin/git', 'fetch', '--no-tags', 'origin', HEAD])
        cmd('revision-log', ['/usr/bin/git', 'log', '--format=%H %cI %s', OLD + '..' + HEAD])
        cmd('revision-stat', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--stat', OLD, HEAD])
        cmd('revision-files', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--name-status', OLD, HEAD])
        cmd('create-pristine', ['/usr/bin/git', 'worktree', 'add', '-b',
                               'bench/xestrata-b9f00e9-pristine-20261013', str(W), HEAD])
        local = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-xe-host-issuer-ledger-20261012/LOCAL.md')
        (W / 'LOCAL.md').write_bytes(local.read_bytes())
        cmd('worktrees', ['/usr/bin/git', 'worktree', 'list', '--porcelain'])
        m.require(not cmd('pristine-clean', ['/usr/bin/git', '-C', str(W), 'status', '--porcelain']), 'clean tracked source')
        m.require(cmd('root-head-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == r['root_head'], 'root unchanged')
        r.update(worktree=str(W), passed=True)
    except BaseException as e:
        r['error'] = repr(e)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, complete=owner.active is None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','error','worktree']}))
    for label in ['revision-log','revision-stat','revision-files']:
        print(label, r['evidence'].get(label, {}).get('stdout',''))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
